name: llama_fwd3
title: Llama-3.1-8B attention forward, generator campaign 2026-11-03 (GPU0): the k_attn_fwd_v1 item body generated by tools/fwd1gen (asmkit), from Primus-Turbo dev/lhz/llama31_8b_hk_opt c2739586
notes: f0 rebuilds the pinned forward (sha 2a8fca7b = llama_fwd2 f0) from llama/hip.
fr is the generator's HIP reference: the fwd3 manifest command without -DHKGEN (adds -amdgpu-expert-scheduling-mode to the f0 flags).

g* rungs: the marker shell (-DHKGEN=1) with the item body (Q/K/V prologue FRONT, stages MAIN / PEN / LAST, epilogue EPI) generated by fwd3/gfx1250_attn/tools/fwd1gen (asmkit: s_set_vgpr_msb, expert-mode waits, v_nop derived), the rest as compiled.
Baseline flydsl: Primus-Turbo FlyDSL gfx1250 d128 forward of $HKL_TURBO_DIR.
Every rung keeps o / lse bitwise equal to f0 (bitwise_with).

baselines.note: Primus-Turbo's FlyDSL gfx1250 d128 forward (main since #580)

rungs.feature: v1.1 + strides (llama_fwd v11_strides): the pinned forward of dev/lhz/llama31_8b_hk_opt
the generator's HIP reference (expert scheduling mode)
generated item body v1 (model MAIN 512 cycles/chunk) (tree of ladder commit 4559290c)
g1 + region-entry va_vdst(0), no stage s_wait_xcnt, ATT latencies (TRANS 15, VALU 5, v_pk 9, VALU->SGPR->SALU 10) (tree of ladder commit 4559290c)
g2 + STAGE_LOOP: stages 0..n-5 of an item in one generated loop (descriptors, burst bases, trip count in the loop; s88..s95 saved in VGPR lanes), rescale blocks out of line, stage scalars in vcc
g4 + TRANS throughput model (v_exp done = max(issue + 18, previous + 4))
g5a + WMMA operand-reuse hints (QK: matrix_a_reuse across a K tile's 4 heads; PV: matrix_b_reuse across a P tile's 8 dt)
